description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Heavy Duty Handle with an ALL ALUMINUM BODY & TEETH
The ENTIRE Handle Body, Including the Gear Teeth is made from Aluminum.
Long Lasting & Heavy Duty
Fits the Driver’s Side (LH) and the Passenger’s Side (RH).
Includes Handle Retainer C-Clips & Escutcheons
Color: Dark Gray
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – METAL – Window Regulator Handles (Heavy Duty)
Qty 2 – PLASTIC – Washers that go behind Window Cranks
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
